items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I used to go sit in with Charlie Cadela and Abby Bernstein at the halfway house and at the Paris Royal later when Abby played there.

ctx.x: You went to Chicago in the early days. Tell me some more about your playing. You probably gave up clarinet.
Well, I used to go sit in with Charlie Cadela and Abby Bernstein at the halfway house and at the Paris Royal later when Abby played there.
Did you ever play professionally or just go around sitting in?
